watchFor: 區分設計、製造、檢驗與整合的角色；只記錄畫面可辨識的部分。
觀察工件如何定位、搬運及交到下一工站，不推測未公開公差。

watchForEn: Separate design, manufacturing, inspection and integration roles; record only identifiable visuals.
Observe locating, handling and station handoffs without guessing undisclosed tolerances.
Keep the industry overview distinct from public IDF development milestones.

courses.overview: 從「經國號與航空製造概念」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend IDF and Aircraft Manufacturing Concepts into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

courses.summary: 經國號的公開歷史，可以讀成一條從原型機出廠、首次飛行到生產階段完成的工程學習路線。這些節點的意義不同：外觀完整、開始飛行與穩定生產，分別需要不同的證據。本地點以漢翔台中廠區代表台灣航空製造網絡，並非宣稱全部工序集中於此；課程限於公開歷史、製造品質與工程安全。
courses.summaryEn: The public history of the Indigenous Defense Fighter offers a learning sequence from prototype rollout through first flight to completion of the production phase. These milestones require different evidence: a complete exterior, a flying prototype and repeatable production are distinct achievements. AIDC’s Taichung campus represents a wider aerospace network, rather than every production operation. The course covers public history, manufacturing quality and engineering safety.

history.title: 首架原型機出廠
history.text: 1988年12月10日，首架原型機A1出廠，並獲命名為經國號。對學徒而言，這是理解原型機與量產件差別的起點：展示一架整合完成的機體，不等於每項驗證都已完成。
history.textEn: The first A1 prototype rolled out on 10 December 1988 and received the Ching-kuo name. This milestone introduces the distinction between a prototype and a production article: presenting an integrated airframe is different from completing every verification activity.

history.title: 首次飛行
history.text: 1989年5月28日完成首次飛行。將它與前一年的出廠日期並列，可以看見「組合完成」與「進入飛行驗證」之間仍有一段工程工作；課程以公開里程碑練習安排驗證關卡。
history.textEn: The first flight took place on 28 May 1989. Comparing this date with rollout makes the interval between physical integration and flight verification visible. Learners use these public milestones to reason about verification gates.

history.title: 生產階段完成
history.text: 漢翔的公開沿革記載，1999年底完成第130架量產機，結束該生產階段。這提供一個討論重複製造的切入點：工程圖版本、零件追溯與檢驗紀錄，如何讓不同批次維持一致。
history.textEn: AIDC records completion of the 130th production aircraft at the end of 1999, closing that production phase. This provides a starting point for discussing repeatability: drawing revisions, part traceability and inspection records help control variation between batches.

courses.connection: 相鄰的土木工程課題是機棚、跑道與製造廠房：機體、地面設備及建築空間必須使用一致的尺寸介面。可先用民用機棚的示意模型練習淨空、通道和維修動線，再把「有圖、有量測、有驗證」的思考轉移到橋梁構件或捷運車體；不延伸至武器製造。
courses.connectionEn: Adjacent civil-engineering topics include hangars, runways and manufacturing buildings, where aircraft, ground equipment and structures share dimensional interfaces. Use a conceptual civilian hangar model to study clearances, access and maintenance routes, then transfer drawing, measurement and verification habits to bridge components or metro bodies. Weapon construction is outside this course.

courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in IDF and Aircraft Manufacturing Concepts. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.
